outcome_against_the_pre_specified_readin._which: (b) THE SEARCH RETURNED ADDITIONAL TRIALS THE REVIEW DOES NOT HOLD. Section 5A of the protocol fixed the reading of this before execution: (b) is a finding about the REVIEW, and each additional trial is named and either included or excluded on a stated axis. It is not a finding about the search.

phase3_empagliflozin_vs_placebo_returned.reason: Title states the trial evaluates 'Clinical Benefit, Safety and Tolerability'. A hierarchical clinical-benefit win ratio is not a time-to-first-event hazard ratio for CV death or HF hospitalisation. Excluded on the MEASURE axis, not on quality.
Title states the primary is exercise ability and heart-failure symptoms.

Title states the population is patients with acute myocardial infarction, not adults with heart failure. Its outcome IS HF hospitalisation and mortality, so the exclusion is on population and must not be described as an outcome mismatch.
Title states it is a mechanistic cardiac magnetic resonance study.

outcome_against_the_pre_specified_readin.THESE_EXCLUSIONS_ARE_PROVISIONAL: Every axis above is read from the registry TITLE returned by the search, not from the trial's registered primary outcome measure. A title is not an outcome definition. Each must be confirmed against the outcome module before any of these is reported as a settled exclusion, and until then this record states five candidates with provisional axes, not five exclusions.
outcome_against_the_pre_specified_readin.what_this_does_and_does_not_say: It says the review's two-trial included set is NOT the whole of what a search returns, and that the additional trials appear to differ on population or measure rather than on quality. It does NOT yet say the included set is correct: that requires the outcome-module check above, and the 676 unexamined PubMed records.

what_this_record_does_not_establish: NOT an adequate search. Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science and Scopus were not searched.
NOT that 776 PubMed records were screened. 100 retrieved, 676 unexamined.
